display_name: Awareness E6: Texts and QR codes (phone only)
description: An eight-minute awareness episode for staff with a work phone, on the defending side only. Six items on a phone at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional haulier: texts, printed notices with QR codes and an email. Some are real and some were built to trick you. Each answer is explained, and reporting a real message never costs you anything.
